The ritual

Five steps, every time

There is a rhythm to it. Consult, cleanse, soften, treat, finish. Nobody rushes a mask, and nobody skips the moisturiser.

  1. Step one

    Consult

    We look at the skin, ask what has changed, what you are hoping for, and what did not work last time. Then we choose the treatment together.

  2. Step two

    Cleanse and exfoliate

    A gentle double cleanse and a soft exfoliation that lifts the dull surface without leaving skin tight or angry afterwards.

  3. Step three

    Steam and soften

    Warm steam opens the pores and settles the skin. This is the part where nobody talks and everybody relaxes.

  4. Step four

    Mask and treatment

    The treatment mask, brushed on and left to work. Blossom, hydration, pigment correction or the wine antioxidant, depending on your skin that day.

  5. Step five

    Finish and protect

    Moisturiser, a short facial massage and SPF advice for the week ahead. Then you sit up slowly, drink your water and look in the mirror.
